events.title: SCARS - Open Day
events.location: Sunshine Coast Animal Refuge, 28 Sippy Creek Road
events.description: Sunshine Coast Animal Refuge proudly presents “Open Day” We will have lots of fun activities and education for families* who want to support rescue cats and dogs and learn how to welcome a new pet into their home. Come and enjoy kids’ activities, education and demonstrations, guided tours of the Shelter, a Doggy Kissing Booth, a charity sausage sizzle, and a coffee van. The SCARS Market will also be open for a special day of sales. ‍As part of the Open Day we will be running our silly Dog Plop Jackpot. Purchase a ticket for a square of land in our dog yard and if one of our rescue dogs plops on your land you will win the jackpot – 20% of the ticket sales. Help us sell all 100 squares of land to raise vital funds for our rescue cats and dogs and make the jackpot reach $10,000!! Purchase your Dog Plop Jackpot ticket here: https://rafflelink.com/r/scars/dogplop26 ‍* We look forward to welcoming visitors of all ages, but please note that this will not be an event for family pets to attend. They will be invited back for Santa Paws later this year.

events.title: Jazz In The Park
events.location: Buderim Village Park, Cnr King & Church Street
events.description: BWMCA Presents: Annual Jazz in the Park Buderim Join us for an afternoon of sizzling hot Jazz entertainment!  Listen to the captivating performances showcasing our local talent on the Sunshine Coast.  The afternoon starts with the next generation of Jazz Musicians on the Coast -   The Sunshine Coast Grammar School Band  followed by The Dean Doyle Quartet  and the Grand Finale presented by the hugely popular June Garber Quintet .  Don’t miss out on this wonderful event! Food stalls and raffles will be available for everyone to enjoy. Please be aware that alcohol is not permitted in the park; however, you may purchase and consume it in the designated area. Visit: https://www.bwmca.com.au/jazz-in-the-park for further information. We extend our heartfelt gratitude to our sponsors: Bendigo Community Bank - Buderim Branch Brent Mickelberg MP Sunshine Coast Council Cage Security Your Mates Brewery

events.title: Zumba With Tianna
events.location: Buderim War Memorial Community Hall, 1 Main Street
events.description: Healthy Sunshine Coast is excited to offer Zumba sessions with Tianna Balmer in Buderim. Zumba is for all ages and abilities. No skills or experience is required. Participants are tought basic, easy to learn movements to follow and dance along to at their own pace. Every class feels like a dance party! Zumba has many benefits; it targets a variety of muscle groups at once, so you burn calories while having fun. When in doubt, dance it out! Every Tuesday: 10.30 am to 11.30 am Provider: Tianna Balmer 0421 833 971 zumbawithtianna@gmail.com Bookings: are required - cash on the day (preferred), eftpos on the day or online - www.trybooking.com/CFSCA Cost: $10 general fee or $5 health care/pensioner card Please note: You must be registered with Healthy Sunshine Coast to join in the activities - registration is one-time, free and easy. Register here: https://our.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/LP=356

events.title: Functional Circuit Training
events.location: Buderim War Memorial Hall - CWA Room upstairs, 1 Main Street
events.description: Healthy Sunshine Coast is excited to offer Functional Circuit Training sessions with Gaye Becker from Just 4 Your Fitness. Functional training is a term used to describe exercise that helps you perform activities in everyday life more easily. These exercises typically use the whole body - definitely multiple muscles - and emphasise core strength and stability. By mirroring the movements of your daily life, like squatting, reaching or even carrying a heavy object, building functional strength can help increase your quality of life and reduce your risk of injury. Every Wednesday CWA room, upstairs at the Buderim War Memorial Hall Provider: Gaye Becker - 0450 870 332 bodyfit.63@gmail.com Bookings: Required - either call or email Gaye. Cost: only $10 general fee or $5 health care/pensioner card Details: Look on Council’s website and search for ‘Healthy Sunshine Coast’, then locate ‘Healthy Sunshine Coast Activities’ and click on the box below. Please note: You must be registered with Healthy Sunshine Coast to join in the activities - Registration is one-time, free and easy. Register here: https://our.sunshinecoast.qld.gov.au/LP=356

events.description: If you have thoughts or concerns regarding the Council, now is the perfect time to connect with your local Councillor. Join us for a conversation with Cr. Ted, your elected representative, to discuss the local issues that are important to you.

events.title: Inspector Drake & The Black Widow by BATS
events.location: Buderim War Memorial Community Association, 50 Burnett Street
events.description: BATS THEATRE COMPANY PROUDLY PRESENTS - INSPECTOR DRAKE AND THE BLACK WIDOW Imagine if Fawlty Towers meets a murder mystery.  That is, essentially, Inspector Drake and the Black Widow. A classic English farce   featuring a cross between ‘Inspector Clouseau’ and ‘And Then There Were None’ will have you laughing out loud and forgetting about the outside world. A dead body is found, whilst dusting at 3am, which sets up a play that is an amusing parody of the whodunnit genre, that’s packed with lots of visual gags, subtle adult innuendo, all topped with a touch of cross-dressing. The plot, set in the 1920s , has Sergeant Plod send for the infamous Inspector Drake to help solve the murder of John Johnson who has been stabbed in the back whilst wearing his wife’s  dress. The two are thwarted by a series of women who look suspiciously alike, with triplets born two months apart, a missing semi-tropical spider and a lustful widow. Just a few of the obstacles facing Inspector Drake. Imagine Basil Fawlty playing Inspector Clouseau playing Inspector Drake?  What can possibly go wrong? From the Team at BATS Theatre, that brought you ‘Sex Please, We’re Sixty’. PERFORMANCE DATES: Friday, 25 September 2026 at 7.30pm Saturday, 26 September 2026 at 2.00pm and 7.30pm Friday, 2 October 2026 at 7.30pm Saturday, 3 October 2026 at 2.00pm and 7.30pm
